Sebastian would curse them and inform Cooper that his friend [[Charles Whiteknife]] was also radicalized by them. He went on to explain that the group has meetings, which he remarks as a "shitshow." Cooper later met with Charles at a bar and got into a debate with him over his [[Communism|communist]] ideology. Before leaving him, Charles suggested that he attend one of their meetings to see what [[Barb Howard]]'s work is truly all about. Eventually, Cooper would drive to [[Hollywood Forever]], where some attendees were seen walking into the building and later walking toward the main meeting room as Cooper followed them. '''Huey''' is an organ harvester {{In|FOTV}}.<ref name="FalloutTV 4">{{fotv|1|4}}</ref>

==Background==
Huey, together with [[Squirrel (TV series)|Squirrel]], manages the organ harvesting business at the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]] with the help of their medical [[Mr. Handy]] robot [[Snip Snip]].<ref name="FalloutTV 4" /> They are under the protection of [[Sorrel Booker]]'s "[[Govermint]]."<ref name="FalloutTV 6">{{fotv|1|6}}</ref>

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Ghouls]]===
Within the Super Duper Mart, Huey sits on a couch beside Squirrel while watching a pre-War cartoon on their [[Television|TV]]. Soon, Snip Snip arrives with [[Lucy MacLean]] tied to a stretcher and announces to them that their latest "arrival" has arrived, and Huey apathetically curses in celebration. Huey then asks Snip Snip what the retriever was asking for, and he answers sixty [[Inhaler vial|vials]].
